name: SwiftAddons for Elementor
author: sandeepdev

sections.description:
SwiftAddons for Elementor is a lightweight addon pack designed to enhance your Elementor page-building experience.
It provides essential widgets to showcase your content beautifully and effectively:

📝 Info Box – Highlight your key services or features with styled info boxes.
👤 Team Member – Introduce your team with photos, names, roles, and social links.
💬 Testimonial – Display client feedback with modern testimonial layouts.

Built for speed and simplicity, SwiftAddons does not bloat your site — it gives you just what you need.

Features

  • Lightweight and optimized for performance
  • Mobile-responsive designs
  • Regular updates and maintenance
  • Clean and well-commented code
  • Easy to use for beginners and developers alike

Support

If you need help with this plugin, please create a support ticket on the WordPress plugin repository.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect, store, or share any personal data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/swiftaddons-for-elementor/ directory, or install it directly from the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Elementor editor and search for Info Box, Team Member, or Testimonial widgets.
  4. Drag and drop the widget into your page and start customizing.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. SwiftAddons for Elementor is an addon for the Elementor Page Builder.

Will it slow down my site?

No. It is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Is it compatible with other plugins?

Yes, it’s compatible with most WordPress themes and plugins.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

No, SwiftAddons works with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.
